title: Non-blocking enrichment: wire location + calendar off the critical path
userStory: As a user, enrichment happens automatically after capture but NEVER blocks me from reviewing/exporting.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/enrichReceipt.js exports enrichReceipt(receipt, { location, calendar, events }) - for a source==='camera' receipt, runs location + calendar enrichment and returns the receipt with context attached; ANY provider failure/denial/slowness resolves to the un-enriched receipt (each wrapped so it cannot reject the whole).
App.js CaptureScreen calls enrichReceipt OFF the critical path after confirmReceiptExtraction; the capture->extract->review->export flow completes regardless of the enrichment outcome.

npm test passes: enrichment attaches context on success; a slow / denied / throwing provider still yields a usable receipt AND the pipeline result is produced (proves non-blocking). App.js source asserts enrichReceipt is wired.
